maya: FYI pushed attention kernel refactor to PR #3421 — CI artifact sizes for runtime_gpu jumped ~22% on the full nvcc matrix.
cheng: can you paste the CI log and the nvcc invocation? where is the bloat coming from (fatbin/PTX vs cubin)?
maya: gist of the command we run in CI:
```
nvcc -O3 --ptxas-options=-v \
  -gencode=arch=compute_70,code=sm_70 \
  -gencode=arch=compute_80,code=sm_80 \
  -gencode=arch=compute_86,code=sm_86 \
  -Xfatbin -compress-all -o build/libattn.a src/*.cu
```
and size diff we see on the artifact: `du -h build/libattn.a` => 37M (pr) vs 30M (main). cuobjdump shows identical PTX sections repeated.
sam: my hunch: fatbin contains PTX+SM code for all archs. Two routes: (A) shorten the gencode list in CI upload jobs (keep long list for regression-only builders), or (B) split per-arch artifacts (one artifact per sm target). we did per-arch split for some kernels before and it trimmed upload sizes.
jenna: also check interactions with LTO and debug symbols. LTO can increase codegen duplication if PTX is preserved. Add linker-level GC + strip: `-Wl,--gc-sections -fdata-sections -ffunction-sections` and strip with `objcopy --strip-unneeded` post-build. But that won't fix PTX duplication if nvcc embeds PTX blobs for each gencode.
maya: cuobjdump summary shows same PTX blob present under multiple sm_xx sections. I suspect we're generating PTX for each arch and embedding it alongside cubin for each sm, so fatbin has repeated PTX. Might be due to our passed `-gencode` combo (sm+ptx for every arch).
cheng: pragmatic CI plan: keep the full nvcc matrix to run tests, but only upload a "trimmed" artifact set for releases/uploads (pick a minimal whitelist of arch targets). make a separate per-arch job for heavy/long builds that we don't store as primary artifact. also add a size-gate that compares artifact bytes against a baseline; fail PR if >15% unless a size exemption is provided. baseline stored in S3.
sam: I can prototype a tiny size check script:```
new=$(du -b build/libattn.a | cut -f1)
old=$(aws s3 cp s3://redwood-artifacts/baselines/libattn.a - | wc -c)
if [ "$new" -gt $((old*115/100)) ]; then echo 'SIZE REGRESSION' && exit 2; fi
```
jenna: +1. Also add a whitelist of allowed flag diffs (e.g., adding a new kernel is allowed to increase size but must be explicitly opted-in in PR body). update PR template to require a size-impact section.

maya: I'll draft an RFC proposing: `REDWOOD_NVCC_ARCH_WHITELIST` env (CI override), artifact split per-arch for uploads, and a size-gate script + exemption flow. will include examples for nvcc flags to minimize embedded PTX (e.g., prefer `code=sm_X` only for uploaded artifacts and `code=compute_X` for fallback builds).
cheng: please include a test matrix for correctness+perf when we reduce the uploaded arch list (we need at least one older-sm and one modern-sm smoke), and note the packaging script changes.
maya: will do — posting RFC to eng-runtime shortly and will @sam @jenna for review :thumbsup:
